notes: Your tuned gold cloud is now the shipped default - the density, size, core, speed, drag, tilt and colour you settled on.
The loader text rows now save as you type rather than waiting for a Save press, so words typed in Options cannot be lost by opening another window.

Removed a shadow from behind the loader word. The word is painted as a gradient clipped to its letters, and a shadow under that combination is a known way to end up with nothing visible - which is the most likely reason the text was not…

The Loader Studio window now takes its colours from the design system instead of the palette that came with the artwork file, so it follows the active theme like every other screen. The vortex's own black ground is deliberately left alone…
